text:
Harper Lin: Quick QC from the design review — while dragging rules in the editor the priority badges shift width and make the list reflow. Also, when you drop a rule into a collapsed group the animation snaps weirdly.
Diego Ruiz: Repro'd. Likely caused by badge width recalculation and group-collapse animation running concurrently. Proposal: reserve badge width via CSS `min-width` and compute target slot on drag-start so collapse doesn't change the target index mid-drag.
Sam K.: For the snap behavior, can we switch to 'snap-to-row' instead of free-follow? The preview should anchor to the closest visible row to avoid teleportation. Also add a small easing so it doesn't feel abrupt.
Nora (a11y): Accessibility notes: 1) keyboard move loses visible focus when the preview overlay mounts; 2) live updates are too chatty for screen readers during fast moves. Pattern: keep focus on the original item and provide an aria-live region with polite updates throttled to 200ms. Suggested string: "Moved 'Block Login' to position 3 between 'Auth' and 'Rate limit'".
Harper Lin: Copy proposal for validation on drop: currently we show "Invalid rule". Change to "Rule invalid: missing condition. Press E to edit or click the rule to fix." Make the action discoverable.
Diego Ruiz: On toasts: they sometimes render under the preview panel. We'll portal them to the modal root and mark them role=status so they don't steal focus. Also raise z-index to modal overlay level.
Sam K.: Virtual list detail: DOM recycling causes ghost-to-row mapping to break. We'll assign stable clientKeys on mount and derive animation targets from those keys rather than DOM indexes.
Nora (a11y): Keyboard announcement sequence: on enter-drag-mode announce "Move mode enabled. Use arrow keys to relocate, Enter to drop, Esc to cancel." On every confirmed move announce the concise live string above. Keep messages short to avoid TTS backlog.
design-helper-bot: Reminder: design sync Friday 3pm PT. Agenda: reserve badge width, snap-to-row animation, aria-live copy, toast portal. Please attach short gifs (max 10s) to the doc beforehand. :spiral_calendar:
Harper Lin: I'll upload a 6s capture showing the badge jitter and a quick mock of the reserved-width badge by EOD. Thanks!
